readings.summary: Decorate every type emitted by the source generator, including formatters, string-key and enum/union formatters, and resolvers, unconditionally with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage.
readings.code_difference: All generation templates must add the fully qualified attribute to each emitted type, including resolver types, and every affected verified snapshot must change; no configuration gate controls emission.

readings.summary: Decorate generated formatter types unconditionally, but leave non-formatter generated types such as resolvers without the attribute.
readings.code_difference: Only the formatter-related templates and their snapshots gain the attribute; resolver generation remains unchanged, so the produced resolver code can still affect coverage.

data.quote: I would like all generated code to be decorated with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute.
